claims.text: TipTour is a macOS menu-bar companion with Jev text tasks and a separate Gemini voice mode.

evidence.quote:
A macOS menu bar companion with two modes, powered by your own API keys.

| Mode | Shortcut | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gemini realtime | Ctrl+Option | Talk about your screen and ask for one desktop action per turn. Press again to stop. |
| JEV text | Ctrl+K | Type a click-based task. JEV chooses from locally detected controls, then TipTour executes and validates each action. |

**JEV is selected by default.** On first launch, choose JEV or Gemini, save that mode’s API key, then grant its permissions. JEV does not require microphone access. You can switch later in **Settings → Models**, which shows only the selected mode’s key field. Keys stay in macOS Keychain. There are no shared keys, hosted key proxies, or keys loaded from other projects.

Shortcuts activate only the selected mode. The primary menu-bar button and welcome hint follow your selection.

claims.text: Jev chooses locally detected controls; TipTour executes and validates clicks while screenshots stay local.

evidence.quote: | JEV text | Ctrl+K | Type a click-based task. JEV chooses from locally detected controls, then TipTour executes and validates each action. |

- JEV supports single, double, and right clicks. It reads screen labels and locations from local detection; it cannot see images or generate replacement text. Use Gemini for writing or keyboard actions.
- Press **Escape** in the text panel or click **Stop** to cancel JEV. JEV acts on its top-ranked target without a confidence cutoff. The loop stops when JEV chooses none or reports completion, on an execution pause/failure, or at its 12-action limit.

Gemini receives microphone audio and, when enabled, screenshots. JEV receives your typed task, locally detected labels/locations, and recent action history; screenshots stay local. Both modes use the shared local grounding and action engine.

claims.text: Select a mode, supply its API key and grant permissions; building requires macOS 14.2+ and Xcode.

evidence.quote: **JEV is selected by default.** On first launch, choose JEV or Gemini, save that mode’s API key, then grant its permissions. JEV does not require microphone access. You can switch later in **Settings → Models**, which shows only the selected mode’s key field. Keys stay in macOS Keychain. There are no shared keys, hosted key proxies, or keys loaded from other projects.

Accessibility permission is needed to inspect and control apps. macOS Screen Recording / Screen Content permission enables screenshots and local screen detection; it does **not** mean TipTour records videos. Microphone access is only needed for Gemini voice.

## Build

Requires macOS 14.2+ and a current Xcode with Swift support. Open `tiptour-macos.xcodeproj`, select the TipTour scheme, set your signing team, and build/run in Xcode. Package dependencies resolve through Xcode.

claims.text: Jev cannot type or interpret images. Its auto-click loop has no confidence cutoff and stops after at most 12 actions.

evidence.quote:
- JEV supports single, double, and right clicks. It reads screen labels and locations from local detection; it cannot see images or generate replacement text. Use Gemini for writing or keyboard actions.
- Press **Escape** in the text panel or click **Stop** to cancel JEV. JEV acts on its top-ranked target without a confidence cutoff. The loop stops when JEV chooses none or reports completion, on an execution pause/failure, or at its 12-action limit.
- Hold **Ctrl+Shift** and paint over an area to give Gemini focus context.
- Hold **Ctrl+Option+Command** for the Speak / Type / Highlight shortcut chooser.
- **Auto-click** lets TipTour act. **Point only** lets Gemini indicate where you should click. JEV requires auto-click.

tr.summary: TipTour, Jev metin görevleri ve ayrı Gemini ses modu sunan macOS menü çubuğu yardımcısıdır. Jev yerelde algılanan kontrolleri seçer; TipTour tıklayıp doğrular, ekran görüntüleri yerelde kalır. Modu seçin, API anahtarını girip izin verin; derleme için macOS 14.2+ ve Xcode gerekir.

sections.heading: Ne işe yarar
sections.text: TipTour, Jev metin görevleri ve ayrı Gemini ses modu sunan macOS menü çubuğu yardımcısıdır.

sections.heading: Jev’in rolü
sections.text: Jev yerelde algılanan kontrolleri seçer; TipTour tıklayıp doğrular, ekran görüntüleri yerelde kalır.

sections.heading: Kullanım
sections.text: Modu seçin, API anahtarını girip izin verin; derleme için macOS 14.2+ ve Xcode gerekir.

sections.heading: Sınırlamalar
sections.text: Jev yazı yazamaz veya görüntü yorumlayamaz. Otomatik tıklamada güven eşiği yoktur; döngü en çok 12 eylemden sonra durur.

it.title: TipTour: clic Jev dalla barra dei menu macOS
it.h1: TipTour: clic Jev dalla barra dei menu macOS
it.description: TipTour offre clic Jev e voce Gemini dalla barra macOS. Jev sceglie controlli rilevati localmente; l’app esegue e verifica ogni clic.
it.summary: TipTour è un assistente macOS con compiti testuali Jev e una modalità vocale Gemini separata. Jev sceglie controlli rilevati localmente; TipTour esegue e verifica i clic, mantenendo gli screenshot sul dispositivo. Scegli modalità, chiave API e permessi; la compilazione richiede macOS 14.2+ e Xcode.

sections.heading: A cosa serve
sections.text: TipTour è un assistente macOS con compiti testuali Jev e una modalità vocale Gemini separata.

sections.heading: Il ruolo di Jev
sections.text: Jev sceglie controlli rilevati localmente; TipTour esegue e verifica i clic, mantenendo gli screenshot sul dispositivo.

sections.heading: Come usarlo
sections.text: Scegli modalità, chiave API e permessi; la compilazione richiede macOS 14.2+ e Xcode.

sections.heading: Limiti
sections.text: Jev non digita né interpreta immagini. I clic automatici non hanno soglia di confidenza e terminano dopo massimo 12 azioni.
